page.overview:
Who is Fate?

The are elderly who weave -shaped quilts in . There are four throughout . Three can be found across inside huts marked with the while one can be found upon a and in the . Each operates a shop where they offer to read fortunes for 10 . In addition, the found in the overworld as well as the in the will sell and for and , respectively, provided the heroes have a . Whenever a hero has fallen, they are taken to a who will return them to .

Whenever the read a hero's fortune, a waypoint will be added to the , pointing the heroes in the direction of their destiny. The power of the has been waning since stole their , , and to construct his . Consequently, the have lost sense of the past and future and have been forced to move in a rhythm by the power of the . Though their ability to see through time has been limited, one of the is able to advise to travel 25 years into the future to stop in the , dismissing the span of time as insignificant. As they have had a significant amount of time to weave, they are capable of doing so with their eyes closed.
